task: Mad-lib cue composition engine (recording-cue-persona-samples worktree, cue-composer stream). Replaces the thin composeFallback direction string with a real slot-based read-aloud passage that mutates with taxonomy selections.

frontend/src/pages/Voices/components/met.summary: NEW pure deterministic composer. composeCuePassage(attrs: VoiceAttributes): ComposedCue { passage, sampleText, directionNote }. 8 tone theme families (comfort/delight/command/gravity/grandeur/shadow/wry/allure covering all 28 taxonomy tones; majority-count pick, declaration-order tie-break), 5 class frames (opener sentence + closing 'keep' noun), 24 timbre texture adj/adv pairs slotted into family sentences, pace restructuring (slow/measured merge sentences, brisk/fast clip at commas/em-dashes, variable mixes), light age tint (child/teen/senior appended clause), gender deliberately no-op. directionNote still built from recordingFragments getFragment().

composeFallback() now delegates to composeCuePassage(); SuggestionResult.sampleText is populated on the composed path (previously always null there — null now only via the overall null return for no-meaningful-attrs). Archetype-match path, scoring, thresholds, and exports unchanged.

frontend/src/pages/VoiceLab/components/r.summary: Doc comment updated to note the composed path now yields a full cueComposer passage; rendering unchanged (prompt + direction note).

frontend/tests/unit/voices/cueComposer.t.summary: 11 unit tests: determinism, class framing swap, tone family swap + majority win, timbre texture words, pace sentence-shape change, age tint, gender no-op, composed-path sampleText populated, null on empty attrs.

flow_impact: Composed-fallback recording cue flow now produces a ~4-sentence read-aloud passage plus a theme-matched TTS sample line; RecordingCueCard and ScriptEditor consume it unchanged via SuggestionResult.
